hook: Your Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth.
title: Your Moon Is Escaping Earth
description:
The Moon moves away from Earth by about 3.8 centimetres every year. Scientists measure it by firing lasers at mirrors left on the Moon by Apollo astronauts and timing the return of the light. It's roughly the speed your fingernails grow.

#Shorts #Moon #Space
